Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1569.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: "Crassus' Home", 2: 'Port Po███', 4: 'Night'}
{2: "Crassus' Home\\nPort Po███\\nNight"}
{3: 'Crassus slowly shuts the refrigerator door.'}
{1: 'He remembers now. He never used to touch alcohol.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'He always told himself never to lose control. At least, not in his own life.'}
{1: 'As the most senior worker at the shipyard, he wanted to set an example for the younger ones.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory201.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'The shipyard had seen too many accidents caused by drinking.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Someone fell off a maintenance scaffold. Someone pushed a crane lever half an inch the wrong way.'}
{1: 'He refused to let those kinds of habits take root under his watch.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory201.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '1'}
{1: 'But somewhere along the line, he cannot recall when, he seems to have gotten used to the taste of alcohol.', 5: '1', 7: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1549.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: 'I was just kidding...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'For a long while, no one at the table speaks.'}
{3: 'The tomato fish soup has just been set on the table, its steam misting the glass.'}
{3: 'The only sounds in the room are the clink of metal utensils against ceramic and the drone of the news on the television.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: '"New reports confirm an unusually violent storm system is expected to reach Port Podesta waters just after midnight."'}
{3: '"Large-scale cloud anomalies have already been observed converging above the port."'}
{3: '"Residents are advised to avoid travel through the night. Coastal operations should secure against high winds and rough seas immediately."'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "The way that sky looks... we're in for a real storm tomorrow. If it hits, the docks will be locked down.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "And that ship still hasn't been towed in...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He mutters to himself.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larene', 3: "You've been getting gloomier with every bite. What's going on?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "If we can't go out tomorrow, we can't go out. It's not the end of the world.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Enid', 3: '...No! You promised me last month, Dad!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "It's not about that...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Crassus cannot describe what he is feeling. The scene in front of him is as ordinary as it gets, yet something about it feels unnatural.'}
{3: 'It is supposed to be a break, but he cannot relax at all.'}
{3: 'Something feels missing. He feels like he should be doing something.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory601.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiRainNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: 'His legs will not stay still. He stands and shoves the window open, letting in a gust of fresh air to blow through the knots in his mind.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'A fine rain is coming down. Far out, the sea carries a red stain, like a signal or a caution he cannot read.'}
{1: 'He looks up. The storm clouds over the signal tower divide the sky into bands of different colors.'}
{1: 'Suspended there is a reflection of crimson.', 7: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiRainNew.prefab'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1569.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1569.jpg'}
{1: 'He takes a deep breath. The scent of flowers mixes with the humid air and fills his lungs.', 5: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1569.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1569.jpg'}
{1: 'It comes from the wildflowers Enid picked from the yard this afternoon, now sitting in a glass vase on the windowsill.'}
{1: 'The petals have softened in the rain-damp air, their scent thicker than it was during the day.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiRainNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory601.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'He stares at the night sky, unsure if it is real or an illusion. The scent suddenly stirs a memory. He has smelled something like this before.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiRainNew.prefab'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1462.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'It was after the Atlantic Calamity. He had been at the docks when it struck. His injuries were minor, but he still spent a few days recovering in the hospital.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'His mind was foggy back then, but he could always catch the faint scent of flowers from the bedside table.'}
{1: 'He knows they were from Enid.'}
{1: 'She was working at the Atlantic Eye back then.', 6: '1'}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory601.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiRainNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: 'His eyes return to the crimson rift. The broadcast grows clearer.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'He knows what is happening.'}
{1: 'But right here, in front of him, is everything he once had.'}
{1: 'In the years that followed, he lived inside the what-ifs until he could only sleep with the help of alcohol.', 6: '1'}
{1: 'He looks up.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'The image suspended in the sky looks too much like the day he most wishes he could forget.'}
{1: 'That was the day he lost Enid.'}
{1: 'He still carried wounds from the Atlantic Calamity back then. With a bad leg that could barely hold him, he searched through the chaos for what felt like forever.'}
{1: 'He thought time would have smoothed all this over by now. It has not. Not at all.'}
{1: 'Watching this unfold, he realizes he has forgotten nothing. The same heavy weight still presses on his chest.'}
{1: 'And this time, he knows exactly what he has to do. He knows it better than anyone.', 7: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiRainNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory601.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1549.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "Larene. There's a storm coming.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "That ship's still sitting out in the dock. No one's watching it this late... I should go help tie things down.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "...But if you don't want me to go, I'll stay.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He walks back from the window, grabbing his coat off the back of the chair as he passes.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larene', 3: "...You've already got your coat in your hands.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Larene pushes herself up from the chair, rising slowly.'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "It's pouring out there. Can't it wait till morning? Someone else will handle it. You're not the only one at that yard.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He does not answer. He just keeps his head down, smoothing the wrinkles from his coat.'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "You've been like this since the day I met you.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "Too much weight on your shoulders. You can't leave things to other people. You have to do it all yourself, and do it right.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "That's exactly why I fell for you back then.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "So now, when you tell me there's something you need to do... how could I stop you?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Enid', 3: "Dad? What's wrong? Why's your face all scrunched up like that?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Enid raises her head, a smudge of soup still on her lips, her gaze quiet and steady beyond her years.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Crassus stands there with his coat in his hands, frozen in place for a long, long moment.'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "Don't worry. I'll take care of myself.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "It's just...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He shakes out the coat, then slowly folds it back over his arm.'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: 'Larene, I... I miss you a lot.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: 'I really do.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "That photo album we had at home... I've gone through it more times than I can count.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "Whenever I've got a quiet moment, I can't help it. I just pick it up.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "Your old clothes, the ones you left hanging in the closet... they're still there. All these years, and I haven't thrown a single thing out. Don't worry.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The man turns to face his wife. The rigid mask of his expression finally softens a little.'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: 'About Enid... I owe you an apology.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: 'Back then... I was still hurting from my own injuries...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "When the Punishing Virus came... I couldn't keep her safe.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: 'I failed her... I failed you...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "I promised I'd watch her grow up.", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: 'But now... seeing her here...', 4: '18'}
{3: 'His eyes rest on Enid for a long moment.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "I don't know... at night, my mind just goes in circles.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: 'And I started drinking. Every day now... The place is practically full of empty bottles...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "I know... it's a bad thing.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: '...What are you talking about? Have you been running yourself ragged at the yard again?', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Larene offers a gentle smile.'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: 'Before you go, finish this soup. I made it myself. At least have a few bites before you head out.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "You can't work on an empty stomach.", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: 'With a smile, Larene cups the bowl of fish soup in both hands and passes it to Crassus.'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "I'm not going to lecture you about the drinking this time.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "But Crassus... you've got to take better care of yourself.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "With no one around to keep an eye on you, you just push and push until you've got nothing left. It worries me.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "And I want you to know... I've always been here. And... I'll always love you.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: 'That sounds so silly saying it out loud. I was always too embarrassed before.', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Enid', 3: "How come you're going to the docks again? What about tomorrow?", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: 'Daddy still has things he needs to do.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "But no matter where he goes, he'll be there for you tomorrow.", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Enid', 3: "Alcohol smells gross, Dad! Don't go sneaking drinks! I can always tell!", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: 'Alright. Go on, Crassus.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: 'Go do what you need to do.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Larene', 3: "When you get back tonight, I'll heat up the soup and the rest of the leftovers for you.", 4: '2'}
{1: 'Crassus takes the soup from her. It is hot.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'The sour tang of tomatoes, the savory depth of fish, and a touch of peppery heat all blend together.'}
{1: "The familiar taste slides down his throat, warm and gentle. It's a flavor no one else could ever make."}
{1: 'For some reason, his throat tightens.'}
{1: 'He knows there are countless others like him in Port Podesta.'}
{1: 'He witnessed the port when the disaster struck, and he lived through the long, bitter years that came after.'}
{1: 'He knows now what he has to do. It is the regrets from his younger days, the things he could never make right.', 7: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "The drinking... I'll ease up. I promise.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "I've gotta go.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Crassus walks to the door and turns the handle.'}
{3: 'Only the damp sea breeze remains, carrying a faint metallic hint of blood.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "I love you both. I'll see you later.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He stands in the doorway, shoulders tensing briefly before he steps through.'}

{1: 'Signal Tower - Corridor', 2: 'Port Podesta'}
{2: 'Port Podesta\\nSignal Tower - Corridor'}
{2: '(Pull the trigger)', 3: '240'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHitQiangHuo.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'Gunfire explodes through the narrow corridor, the sound bouncing off the walls. The Corrupted ahead drops instantly.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 4: '8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 4: '8', 5: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'More of them emerge from around the stairwell corner, joints bent backward, bodies crouched low. They step right over their fallen without pause.'}
{3: 'This chase through the dark feels like it will never end.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'A Corrupted circles the main console and lunges at you from the flank.'}
{3: 'You twist aside on instinct. The cold claw scrapes past your waist and crashes into the edge of the console.'}
{2: 'Leia, you still with me?', 3: '270'}
{3: 'You slip out through the doorway. Only static hisses from the communicator now.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab', 2: '2'}

{3: 'Behind you, the dull scrape of metal claws tearing through the wall echoes through the space. Brick fragments and dust explode into the air, and the entire corridor disappears into a cloud of debris.'}
{3: 'Iron claws shoot out of the smoke and drag across the concrete, trailing sparks. They slice through fabric and graze skin before burying themselves in the wall beside you.'}
{2: '(Raise your weapon)', 3: '288'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHitQiangHuo.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHitQiangHuo.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHitQiangHuo.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: "Several shots punch into the Corrupted's chest. The muzzle flash briefly lights up the control room and the dead announcement screen overhead."}
{3: 'A red glow pulses in the distance, closing in fast. The sound of footsteps scatters through the dark.'}
{2: '(Push yourself upright)', 3: '301'}
{3: 'At the end of the corridor, a sudden rush of footsteps breaks out.', 17: '1'}
{3: 'The sharp whine of a buzzsaw follows right behind.', 22: '1'}
{3: "The saw blade rips through the Corrupted's back. Sparks and machine parts burst outward in a spray of metal debris, carving a long scar across the wall."}
{3: 'The motor screams louder.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'From the deep dark, a figure slides down a silken thread and lands lightly atop the wreckage.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: "Sorry for the delay. But looks like you're still in one piece, 【kuroname】.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'A mechanical spider clicks out from under her collar and springs back onto her fingertips in a few small hops.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "You're hurt. Let me patch you up.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She leans down and lifts her fingers. Several mechanical spiders glide down silken threads from her cuffs and climb silently onto your clothing.'}
{3: "A soft click sounds as one spider's abdomen opens, releasing a thread of pale blue gel that spreads over the wound."}
{3: "It's cold at first. Then a faint, numbing warmth slowly radiates from the injury."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Hold still. This might sting.', 4: '1'}
{2: "What's the situation out there...?", 3: '334'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'The anomalies "Understanding" created are breaking down.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'That broadcast just now... it reached people.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'You made it happen.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Your nerves, wound tight for so long, finally loosen for just a moment.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "But Port Podesta still hasn't stopped. It's only... slowed down a little.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'And Ophelia?', 3: '344'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "Ophelia... gave the Sefirah's authority to me.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "That's how we were able to crack open a fissure of resistance inside Understanding's illusion.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She presses her lips tight.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "But she's not here anymore.", 4: '1'}
{3: "She averts her gaze and tightens her hold on the buzzsaw's handle."}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "【kuroname】, let's head to the Tidal Hub.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'We have to stop this city and put an end to these false illusions.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "It's what she asked of us.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Understood.', 3: '359'}
{2: 'We regroup with Leia first.', 3: '360'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory307.png'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.8', 5: '0'}
{1: 'Signal Tower', 2: 'First Floor', 4: 'Port Podesta'}
{2: 'Port Podesta\\nSignal Tower\\nFirst Floor'}
{3: 'You push through the half-fallen fire door. Chaos greets you on the other side.'}
{3: 'Broken steel beams crisscross in tangled heaps. Shattered glass pools across the floor like dark, still water.'}
{3: 'In the center of the lobby, Leia braces against a stone pillar. Her light whip lashes out, cinched tight around the throats of four Corrupted.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "You guys just don't quit! One at a time, ever heard of that?!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She pushes off the ground with her right foot and spins with the momentum.'}
{3: 'Three Corrupted are yanked off their feet by the motion and hurled into the far wall.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'She lands, dropping to one knee.'}
{3: 'Nearby, the bodies of several Corrupted sail through the air, and two familiar figures come into view.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: '【kuroname】! Helentine!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: 'Heads up, more on the stairway landing!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Several Corrupted burst out from your blind spot around the corner.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Helentine raises her buzzsaw and blocks the first wave.'}
{3: 'The teeth clash against Corrupted shells, throwing sparks.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHitNew.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '1'}
{3: 'She pivots and sweeps the buzzsaw horizontally, cutting the two front runners in half.'}
{3: 'But deeper in the corridor, more Corrupted are closing in.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0.8', 4: '0', 5: '0'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront88.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.8', 5: '0'}
{3: 'Then, with a screech of metal, the sealed door beside you bursts open from the inside, and a beam of light floods through.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: 'In here! The exit passageway! Our people cleared this path. Get everyone through!', 4: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory967.png'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: 'Your group retreats swiftly through the side door. Crassus grabs Leia and pulls her through as the last one, then shoves the door shut and braces it.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: 'Heads down!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'BOOM. The explosives roar, deafening.'}
{3: 'Girders and shattered pillars and slabs of concrete come down in a thunderous cascade, sealing the doorway and every Corrupted behind it inside a tomb of debris.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "That'll keep 'em busy. They'll have to find another way around.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He wipes the rain from his face.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Behind him, one pair of keen, bright eyes after another appears.'}
{3: 'Some carry hydraulic cutters. Others have portable welding torches strapped to their backs.'}
{3: 'A few hold nothing more than a length of steel pipe.'}
{3: 'Their faces still carry the exhaustion of dreams that have just faded.'}
{3: 'Yet every one of them is standing here, right in front of you.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Worker A', 3: 'Crassus! Outer shutters are all sealed!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Worker B', 3: "Those tin cans aren't getting through anytime soon! We'll hold as long as we can!", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Several workers surge out from behind Crassus and spread through the wreckage in front of the signal tower.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wynne', 3: "Leia... you're okay. Thank goodness.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Wynne slips out from behind as well, a crowbar clutched in her hand.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "It's just been a little while, and you're already this beat up? Come on, girl!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "Crassus! Wynne! You're both okay!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wynne', 3: "I'm fine. My head's still pounding a bit, but... I'm fine.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The man flashes a grin and walks up to you.'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: '【kuroname】.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: 'I heard your broadcast.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "This is Port Podesta's fight. We're not sitting this one out. That's why we're here.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "We've all seen what we needed to see... but none of it was real. Port Podesta doesn't need some pretty dream that destroys everyone in its wake.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'He hesitates, and his voice drops.'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: 'What Tavis did to this city... we want answers. We want him to answer for it.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "But until then... we're not handing Port Podesta over to anyone.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "We've lived our whole lives here. The last traces our families left behind are in this city.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "We won't let anyone take even that from us. It's all we've got left.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Thank you, for coming here.', 3: '532'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: 'Not much else to say. Everyone who can still move and still wants to fight is here.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "You're from Babylonia, a commandant and a Construct. We need your help to save this city and those out there.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "Port Podesta's slowed down, but it hasn't stopped... The terrain outside is a mess. We don't know exactly what's going on either.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "But we know these streets. Even if we have to blow up a few of them, we'll get you to the Tidal Hub.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'But if you do that, then Port Podesta...', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "If this city crashes into Constellia, there won't be any Port Podesta left anyway.", 4: '1'}
